notes.title: DLC Tome of Dimensions release date!
notes.notes:
We're very excited to announce that very soon, on April 21, will be released the major DLC Tome of Dimensions with a new playable character. Meet Sibyl! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34384227/5473fe5049b8b23d64a8a7121b6d4874d680e8d3.jpg

Her race had disappeared in another dimension long before the humans emerged in this world. All the years of her loneliness Sibyl had been looking for a way to get her kin back. It got harder with a humans around so she used magic to disguise as one of them. The Rogues could be of some help to her so she joined them. But with the Ash box destroyed and her disguise spell dispelled time started to run out for Sibyl to save her race...

[previewyoutube=VnZCxkMy2RE;full][/previewyoutube]

Tome of Dimensions adds new playable character with unique storyline, 100+ new cards to experiment with, and, of course, a variety of new deadly enemies!

And for sweets... *drumroll* ... On April 21, Deck of Ashes will come to Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo Switch. Now your console friends will go on a hard adventure too, and you can discuss the best deck and strategy options together!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34384227/b798dd417e6b2a102ca6f37a300e314c1ecdd3df.jpg

Hello everyone, friends! This time we have a major update, which includes numerous wishes of community and our long-standing features! :)

NEW POISON

Note: the change of poison affects both monsters and the player. 
Now poisoning immediately imposes 4 stacks of poison, and the effect decreases by 1 for each move made by player.
The effect can be reduced by treatment cards, as well as cards that reduce the negative effect.

https://media.giphy.com/media/UsAkcw7zUxBGF8T8kg/giphy.gif

CARDS CHANGES & REBALANCE

 Scales of Avarice: damage reduced from 5 to 3;
 Champion’s Pauldron: now instead of regeneration, 1 disease would be destroyed;
 Impartial fire: now after applying the card you take doubled damage until the end of the battle;
 Countdown: triggers the pyrobomb effect on the enemy and imposes burning on him;
 Barbed Boomerang: damage increased to 8-12 (was: 5-10). Damage to the player is reduced by 2-3 (was 2-5);
 Healing Blood: restore 5 Health for each bleeding inflicted on an opponent;
 Ash Sphere: Now deals 5 damage + 1 more damage for each discarded card in battle;
 Short Respite: reduces the player’s speed by 1. Receive: 6 Health and 1 strength in two turns.

REWARD SCREEN

Now you can spend your faithfully earned Reward Points whenever you want. Just press the "Spend reward points" button in the main menu of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34384227/889321c6ef552759aedce566e247bc5a50d95d03.png

UPDATED DIFFICULTY SELECTION WINDOW

We remove the intermediate level of difficulty (Marauder), which only confused the new players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34384227/4f913c016b4b58294c28c0486f28d14004a762d7.png

THIRST FOR ALCHEMY

We decided that you guys are rarely use potions, so we add a 100% chance of dropping a random potion from any chest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34384227/4d089e5b64fd216eee4dc3b7633816700222b985.png

IMPORTANT CHANGES

 TORMENTER talent was changed: opponents deal 1% less damage for every Poison applied on them;
 The Ash Pact now takes 10 Health (was 20) on difficulty levels Wanderer and Adventurer;
 Now at resolutions 1366x768 and less, cards will be displayed more zoomed when hovering over them;
 Praise the sun players on laptops: now you can zoom in and out using the “+” and “-” buttons;
 Potions are now on the same tab as recipes.


DON'T FORGET TO UPDATE THE GAME!

FACEBOOK - fresh content everyday! 
DISCORD - discuss your deck with the community 
INSTAGRAM - plenty of animated monsters :)
TWITTER - stay in touch with us!

notes.title: BOMBTASTIC UPDATE
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34384227/6f8c05c1c97d4b557c54c0b4fd07197b9846bbc0.jpg

Hi, everybody!

Today we’re happy to introduce a new type of cards, added to the game with update 169:

PYROBOMB IS THE NEW ARCHETYPE FOR LUCIA!

(archetype is a set of cards with a common mechanic)

NEW ARCHETYPE: PYROBOMB

This archetype includes 10 new cards, which are closely connected to each other by a new term in the game - Pyrobomb. Pyrobomb does periodic damage, with a delayed detonation at the end of its duration. When applied, Pyrobomb does 3 damage to the target each turn, for 4 turns, and at the start of the 4th turn it detonates for 12 extra damage. Most of the new cards interact with Pyrobomb in different ways, and many have an additional effect.

Let’s look at a couple of examples:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34384227/d23b6604b779f1d02c9cd36318daa77135a45e95.png

[Stun Bomb] 
Apply Pyrobomb on the opponent.
After triggering any Pyrobomb, put a Stun on the character on whom it worked.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34384227/1af27e5240cf585ec665886f58cadb0c0daab230.png

[Explosion Protection]
Choose an opponent. Get a Shield for each Pirobomb applied on him.

Pyrobomb works well with the archetype's cards, but it’s also good for mixing with other decks, you need only to find the right recipe and craft the cards using it.

Pyrobomb has a more passive playstyle than other archetypes - you apply many Pyrobombs on different targets and complement the strategy with additional effects, like healing and shields.

NEW FEATURE: SPACE BAR

With EA update 169 a brand new feature was added to the game - now pressing Space Bar in different situations will have an effect:


 Confirm card selection in battles
 Skip enemy animations in battles
 End your turn, return phase in battle
 Skip NPC dialogue (camp, map, battle)
 Close tutorial messages, Boss messages
 Jump to the end of the Ash Storm animation


We hope you will like the new additional way to control the game!

DON'T FORGET TO UPDATE AND HAVE A GREAT WEEKEND! ːsteamhappyː

HOTFIX IS HERE!

Thank you very much for all the amazing feedback you've given us on Day 1! We are committed to make Deck of Ashes better and better with every update, and your help is much appreciated!

Alright, the hotfix arrived with a ton of good stuff! We have addressed most of the issues reported so far. We investigate the other issues, and their fixes will come in the next patch.

Enjoy the game!


PATCH NOTES (EA Build 162)

Bug fixes
● In rare cases, the game would reset language settings.
● Duplicate screen resolution settings removed from options.
● Dexterity Potion now correctly has the description for Return keyword.
● It is no longer possible to have a negative amount of resources after specific events on the map.
● Lady Death can no longer create additional Shard of Ash Box cards.
● Shard of the Ash Box is now correctly renewed if discarded by any means.
● Dying with an active basic Resurrection Rite effect now correctly removes half of the recipes and half of the resources.
● Keyword description popups no longer get stuck on screen after leaving battle or collection screen while hovering over a card.
● Loading screen errors leading to infinite loading are fixed.
● The text on the purchase button will no longer overlap with the cost of a stat item at the Herbalist's.
● Fixed the issue where the player avatar was unable to move after fighting Lady Death in a previous playthrough.

Monster fixes

● Bone Prison card effect is now working correctly.

Localization fixes

Monster Cards:
● Massacre (Cannibal) - card text now visible for French, German, Japanese and Chinese languages.

Pyromancer cards:
● Piercing Fire - fixed wrong damage description

Other improvements:
● Character selection screen - Sly's description was fixed.
● Story screen typos fixed.
● Treasury and Resurrection Rite descriptions are now correctly displayed in all localizations.
● "Goods restocks in:" Camp notification fix.
● The text of Burnt Offering trait is now correctly displayed.
● Minor localization improvements all around.

Today we’re showing you an early version of Pyromancer cards. In the game, it’ll be different, but just see how stunning it is!

Pyromancer’s got some powerful cards with fiery effects. With them she’s is unstoppable.

She takes one of them and throws it at the enemy. Monster hisses and squirms desperately trying to put out its burning hide. A grin crosses Pyromancer’s face.

The flames will do the rest.
